# Casher

> Casher helps UK freelancers and individuals spot and cancel unused subscriptions by analyzing CSV bank statements. No bank login required.

Casher is a privacy-first web and mobile app. Users export a CSV from their bank, upload it to Casher, and get auto-categorized spending plus a list of recurring subscriptions to review and cancel. Free, Pro (£9.99/mo), and Premium (£14.99/mo) tiers are available.

- [About](/about): Why CSV-only, security model, and mission.
